subject: Civil Engineering Draftsperson, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK, with my resume and cover letter attached as the ad asks.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 and draft in AutoCAD in 2D and 3D. I've also built a 3D model in Revit, a pedestrian truss bridge, so I've worked through truss geometry before, if only in a model. In the diploma I prepared and reviewed drawings to Australian Standards, which is the part of this role I'd be strongest in from day one. I haven't used Pryda software yet, so I would need to learn it, and I'd put the hours in.

I have about a year of site experience in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020, reading architectural and structural drawings, checking work against them, dealing with suppliers and keeping clients updated on progress. Customer contact wouldn't be new to me.

I live in Melton and have my own transport, so Somerton is a commute I can do. I hold a White Card and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.

Would you be open to a short conversation about the role?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.subject: Application for Civil Engineering Draftsperson
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK. Melbourne Truss has made prefabricated roof trusses, wall frames and floor trusses in Somerton for two decades as a licensed Pryda fabricator. Drafting for a manufacturer appeals to me because the drawings are what the factory builds from, so they have to be right. Somerton is also a commute I can do from Melton.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. In the coursework I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D applying Australian Standards, designed and documented road, earthworks, pavement and drainage work, prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, and compared design options in writing. I also modelled a pedestrian Warren truss bridge in Revit and a footing and column in AutoCAD 3D. My Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) covered structural principles and construction methods.

On site in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against them, tracked procurement and materials, coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors, and kept clients updated on progress. That covers the customer-facing and documentation side of this role.

To be straightforward about the gaps: I have not used Pryda build software and have not drafted timber trusses commercially, so I would need training on both. I work carefully and I'm keen to keep learning. I hold a White Card, a driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to come in and show you my work.
